citation: Hjorth M, Galigniana NM, Ween O et al. (2022). Postprandial Effects of Salmon Fishmeal and Whey on Metabolic Markers in Serum and Gene Expression in Liver Cells. Nutrients 14(8):1593.
protocol: Two protein drinks, randomised crossover: 5.2 g protein from salmon fishmeal vs from whey (fishmeal 13.2 g fat/100 g; whey 6.5 g fat and 8 g sugar per 100 g). Venous blood at 0, 30, 60 min.
population: n=5 healthy men, aged 33-45, BMI 21.5-24.0 kg/m2.

reports.where: Table 3: serum glucose at 0, 30, 60 min per protein, mean (SD)

note: Paired-meal contrast, protein_source: salmon fishmeal vs whey at matched protein grams. Fish against dairy protein with time points tabulated. Watch: tiny dose (5.2 g protein), n=5 and only 60 min, so the effects are small; fat and sugar per serving are not exactly matched.
